create_sampler_sequential: create a SequentialSampler to iterate over dataset indices in order
create_sampler_random: create a RandomSampler to draw random indices from a dataset with or without replacement
create_sampler_weighted: create a WeightedRandomSampler to sample indices by given probability weights
create_sampler_subset_random: create a SubsetRandomSampler to shuffle a fixed list of dataset indices
create_sampler_batch: create a BatchSampler to wrap another sampler and yield mini-batches of indices
